domain_mappings.decision: E001 (Temporal cutoffs and rolling split isolation)

domain_mappings.decision: E005 (Ridge and Ensemble co-champions within 0.10m indifference threshold)
domain_mappings.rationale: Point MAE tie band (+/- 0.05 min) prevents declaring a single point victor.

domain_mappings.decision: E007 (Role B: marginal quantile forecast champion, forecast-only)
domain_mappings.rationale: P5 predicts 9 marginal quantiles with superior pinball loss; lacks continuous density; barred from sampling.

domain_mappings.decision: E008 (Role C: certified continuous downstream stochastic engine)
domain_mappings.rationale: P4 yields exact closed-form Student-t parameters (mu, sigma, nu); certified as continuous sampler.

domain_mappings.decision: E009 (Decoupled multi-attribute utility: Role B for P5, Role C for P4)
domain_mappings.rationale: Strictly blocks unscientific claim of a single joint overall champion.

domain_mappings.new_domain: Domain 06: Common Random Numbers Variance Reduction
domain_mappings.decision: E010 (Retraction of 82.4% CRN variance reduction claim)
domain_mappings.rationale: Pilot observation failed to replicate across diverse operational seeds; marked NOT_SUPPORTED.

domain_mappings.new_domain: Domain 07: Monte Carlo Sample Size & Convergence
domain_mappings.decision: E011 (N=500 is canonical operational compromise, not global mathematical optimum)
domain_mappings.rationale: Establishes empirical s/sqrt(N) convergence; retracts optimality claim.

domain_mappings.decision: E012 (Airfield results strictly bounded to synthetic simulation)
domain_mappings.rationale: Turnaround (45m min turn, 15m buffer) simulated; strictly bans real-world ATL operations claims.

domain_mappings.decision: E013 (Acausal oracle plan demonstrates extreme fragility under stochastic shocks)
domain_mappings.rationale: Fixed plans tuned to realized point actuals collapse under continuous Student-t realizations.

domain_mappings.new_domain: Domain 10: Downstream Gate Optimization & Equal-Compute Solvers
domain_mappings.decision: E014 (Equal wall-clock compute ceiling: 2.0s per solver instance)
domain_mappings.rationale: Solvers compared under identical compute budgets; CP-SAT proves optimal; Hybrid matches CP-SAT optimum.

domain_mappings.decision: E015 (Day-cluster bootstrap on FL_DATE with Holm-Bonferroni FWER control)
domain_mappings.rationale: Protects against unadjusted p-value claims; enforces paired comparisons.

domain_mappings.decision: E003 & E006 (Strict exclusion of weather, departure delays, and 27 .pt raw flight chains)
domain_mappings.rationale: Core Arrival is 100% tabular with zero leakage from auxiliary tasks.

domain_mappings.decision: E016 (Certified With Limitations; mandatory cryptographic freeze and SHA-256 sidecars)
domain_mappings.rationale: Enforces byte-for-byte reproducibility; explicitly flags missing dashboard presentation layer.
